name: Mexican milkweed
desc: Mexican milkweed (Asclepias fascicularis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias fascicularis is a species of milkweed known by the common names narrowleaf milkweed and Mexican whorled milkweed. It is a perennial herb that grows in a variety of habitats.
